regional-tokyo.jpg.depicts: A wide-angle landscape photograph of the Tokyo skyline captured during the "golden hour." The image features a dense concentration of skyscrapers in the Minato ward. The iconic Tokyo Tower, a communications and observation tower inspired by the Eiffel Tower, stands prominently in the center with its distinctive white and international orange lattice. To the left is the Roppongi Hills and Azabudai Hills. Taken from Shibuya Stream's 35th floor.
